Equipment and sites

Every machine with its model, serial number, location, department, criticality and the whole history of what has been done to it. Each one carries a QR code that opens its record on a phone.

Criticality sets the priority

The level on a machine decides where its faults sit in the queue and how quickly a failure escalates.

1 LowRoutine work, no urgency
2 MediumWatched, scheduled regularly
3 HighFast response needed on failure
4 CriticalProduction stops when this stops
A record per machine

Model, serial number, acquisition date, supplier, department and location. Sub-equipment hangs off the parent, so a line and its components stay related.

A QR code on the machine

Scanning it opens the equipment record. From there anyone can raise a request without an account, and signed-in users can open a work order or enter a meter reading.

Status history and availability

Online, offline and untracked periods are recorded per machine, with planned and unplanned stops separated. That history is where availability and MTBF come from.
